ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Crassus Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Crassus, a Windows privilege escalation discovery tool, based on PE metadata characteristics.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\Crassus\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Crassus\.exe" OR process_description = RGX(".*Crassus.*"))
